Players Committee card image of [[Val]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “May forfeit in place of your 'hit' [Set 13] smuggler here, restoring that smuggler to normal. Permanent weapon is Blaster Pistol (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Val.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Val.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
